title: Mark Cuban alleges Facebook knowingly profits from AI deepfake scam ads
summary: Mark Cuban publicly alleged that Facebook knowingly runs AI deepfake scam ads and profits from them, according to a report whose headline cites documents putting fraud revenue at $16 billion. The figure is attributed to reported documents rather than an audited Meta disclosure, and the supplied material does not describe those documents or include any Meta response, so both the characterization and the number remain allegations rather than verified results. No technical detail on how the ads evade detection, or on any change to Meta&\#x27;s ad review, is available in the source.

references.title: Deepfakes are wrecking influencers’ credibility, one fake ad at a time
